lines.text: Little Mermaid opens her eyes beneath the ocean.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: underwater?
Little Mermaid swims up to the surface.
*Splash*
She looks around.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Where am I...?
An unfamiliar sight comes into view, one that looks nothing like the area around the Lift.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Did I get separated from everyone...?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Where is everyone...?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Cinderella? Abe! Hansel!! Gretel!!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: There's... no one here.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Could something have happened to everyone?!
Little Mermaid claps her hands over her mouth.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: N-no...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I have Kotodama... so I shouldn't say things like that.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... I-I'm sure they're still alive.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: They're alive. Yeah. Th-that's what I'll believe...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... I have to go find them.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: With my bubbles, I'm sure I'll be able to find them quickly.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Everyone... I'll find you, I promise.
Little Mermaid hugs her bubble close and prays.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: So please... just be alive.
Soon, Little Mermaid sets off to find her friends.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: How strange...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I've been swimming around for a while now, but nothing looks familiar.
However, no matter how far she travels,
she finds neither a place she recognizes nor anyone she knows.
As time passes, she eventually reaches a beach beneath a cliff...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: ... Siren?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hansel?
At last, Little Mermaid finds the first of her friends.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Siren...!!
Hansel runs toward Little Mermaid.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hansel!
They wrap their arms around each other in a tight hug.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Where's Gretel?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel is...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: really hurt.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I-is she getting treatment...?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: She is.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: She hasn't woken up yet, but... I'm sure she will soon!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: After all... she said she'd wake up soon.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Thank goodness...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: What about Cinderella and Abe?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I think they're dead.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: D-d-dead...? H-how did you...? D-did someone tell you?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: They didn't come to the lab.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: No one came to our meeting place.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I... see.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I waited for a long time... I waited for so long...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: But they never came.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: So... they must be dead.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Otherwise...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: There's no way Abe would forget the promise we made.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: But...
Little Mermaid wants to tell her about all the terrible things that could have kept them from coming even without them dying,
but she's afraid that saying them might accidentally turn them into reality through her Kotodama.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ahh... ah woo...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Hey, Siren...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Humanity betrayed us.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: They say nobody remembers us anymore.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Nobody remembers me, Gretel, you, Cinderella, or Abe...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Even when I told them Gretel was hurt, nobody came to help us.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah... woo?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: And yet, the one who saved us back then... was a Heretic.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Funny, isn't it?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Huh? Wh-what did you just—

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: She's a little different from Cinderella back then, so maybe she's not really a Heretic after all.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I mean, I did sign a contract with her, but...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: A contract...?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: She did save me and Gretel, so she's gotta be a good person...!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hansel.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Heretics... are our enemies.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: What do you mean, you signed a contract with one of them?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I don't fight for humanity anymore,

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: so Heretics aren't my enemies.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: So, Siren,

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: why don't you stay here, too?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Stay with me,

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: and let's fix Gretel together.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hansel...
Just then, Little Mermaid thinks of someone.
A friend who deceived everyone with her flawless acting and silver tongue.
Someone who turned Cinderella into a Heretic and ruined their tale.
Red Shoes.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: We can't coexist with Heretics.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You remember what happened... when Cinderella became one.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: No. I told you, she's different from Cinderella!
Watching Hansel defend a Heretic,
Little Mermaid grows alarmed at the thought that Hansel might be getting deceived by someone like Red Shoes.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hansel.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: We need to get out of here right n—

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: And who might you be?
Little Mermaid turns toward the voice.
A woman holding a parasol looks back at her.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: I took you for one of my pursuers...

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: But it seems you're my slave's guest.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Slave...?
Little Mermaid notices the woman's red eyes.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: A Heretic...!

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: How perceptive of you.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hansel, the contract you said you made with this Heretic...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It wasn't a slave contract, was it?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: ... It is.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: A-a slave contract...?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Siren?
Little Mermaid uses her Kotodama on the woman.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Stop.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: Oh?
The woman remains completely still, as if frozen in place.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: Hmm, I take it you know how to wield kotodama.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Siren, what are you doing?!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Set my friend free,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: or I'll attack.
Dozens of small bubbles form around Little Mermaid.

lines.speaker: parasolwoman
lines.text: Set her free?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Stop... Don't attack her!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Run, Hansel. I'll take care of that Heretic—

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I said stop!
*Click*
Hansel aims the Witches Cauldron at Little Mermaid.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hansel...?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: D-don't attack her.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: She's the one saving Gretel's life, remember?!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I told you she was helping her, so why are you attacking her?!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: She's the only person who can fix Gretel. She's the only one!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: That's not true, Hansel. Once we find Abe—

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Abe didn't come. She never came looking for Gretel and me!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I told you, she's dead!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: No, I'm sure she's still—

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: There's no way she's alive. If she were, she would've come looking for me by now!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I can't wait any longer.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I can't... I can't do this alone without Gretel...
*Whirr*

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Huh...?
Light begins to emanate from the Witches Cauldron.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Wh-why can't I control—

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Siren, move!
*Boom!*
A burst of light shoots out from the Witches Cauldron,
filling Little Mermaid's vision with a cloud of green light.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: What's this?!
*Kaboom!*
Decades later, in the present day...
Riding atop a bubble as it drifts across the distant sea,
Little Mermaid finishes recounting what happened all those years ago.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... So you took the full force of Hansel's attack?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: No. Thankfully, I wasn't hit directly.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I think I was safe because that green cloud of light protected me.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: But even so, the impact knocked me back into the ocean,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: and I ended up drifting toward you, Cinderella...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I see. So that's what happened.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: To think they were with a Heretic...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: She was definitely a Heretic, but...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: something felt off about her.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It was like she didn't have any hostility toward Nikkes...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: At first, I thought she was holding Gretel hostage to keep Hansel in check, but...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I think she was the one who kept me from getting hurt back then, too.
Something resembling a firefly flies toward the bubble surrounding Little Mermaid.
"Miss Mermaid,
I believe it would be best for you two to take some time apart for now."

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I'm sure I heard a message from her beneath the ocean.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... That Heretic actually said that?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah woo.
Little Mermaid nods.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Now I know there are Heretics who aren't hostile toward Nikkes, like Levi and the Four Beasts.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: But back then, I didn't think such Heretics existed.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I sent out another bubble to make sure,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: but then I learned it couldn't cross the ocean because of the Island Eater.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I decided to look for you and Abe first, but I eventually collapsed from exhaustion.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: That's when Levi found me.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Then Gluttony swallowed me, and before I knew it, all these years had passed.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You said Hansel and Gretel couldn't fight alongside us

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: because they no longer wanted to fight for humanity... and because they were with a Heretic.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah woo.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Back then... Hansel genuinely didn't want to fight for humanity anymore,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: and I thought I'd hurt her by not accepting how she felt.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: So I thought maybe I should just give up.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: But after meeting the Prince and the Four Beasts, I learned just how powerful communication can be.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: And watching Marciana, Naga, and Tia,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I learned that even if we can't be together in the future, we can still trust each other and wish each other well.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: That's why I have to go back.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I want to see Hansel and Gretel and talk to them again.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I want to hear how they've been, and how they want to live from now on.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... You're right.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: At the very least, we should say goodbye and wish them well.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Besides, I'm curious about that Heretic.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah woo!

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: But Cinderella,

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: we don't have much time.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: The Rapture Queen is descending to the surface.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: It took longer than expected to cross the ocean.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Yeah, I didn't think it'd take this long...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Grave is right.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: If what Siren said is true, then the Queen may already be on the surface.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Which means...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: An all-out war is drawing near,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: and the Prince will surely have to face the Queen in battle.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: With the Rapture Queen...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... Ah woo.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: We must lend him our strength.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: ... She's right. We must help him.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: We should hurry.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah woo!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I'll pick up the pace a little.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Please do.
Little Mermaid starts speeding up her bubble.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Um... Grave?

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You don't remember anything about Hansel and Gretel, do you?

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I saw their faces through Siren's bubbles, but...

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Nothing came to mind.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I do have a vague memory that a long time ago, there were two people who looked exactly alike.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: That's all. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: No, you have nothing to apologize for.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I know you never wanted this, Grave.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Everyone, look!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I see land!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Siren, those two on the cliff look familiar...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah woo?
Little Mermaid gazes toward the cliff Mori is pointing at
and spots Hansel and Gretel.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hansel, Gretel...!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: They're your friends, right?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... Yes, they're dear friends of mine.
